mapper.select: SELECT type, id as referenceId, title, createdAt, category, userId, userName FROM ( SELECT 'party' AS type, p.id, p.title, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.category, u.id as userId, u.name as userName FROM party p JOIN users u ON p.owner_id = u.id UNION ALL SELECT 'recommendation' AS type, r.id, r.store_name AS title, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.category, u.id as userId, u.name as userName FROM recommendation r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 ) recent_activities ORDER BY createdAt DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
